blocks.text: Haal hi mein molecular biology ne evolutionary rishton ke bare mein bohat si maloomat di hain. Jis tarah janwaron mein homologous structures hote hain, usi tarah un mein homologous biochemicals (milte julte kimiyai maadde, jaise proteins) bhi ho sakte hain. Aakhir kaar jism ki banawat aur kaam genetic blueprint (DNA molecule, jism banane ka naqsha) par qaim hain jo tamam zinda janwaron mein paya jata hai.

Aapas mein rishta rakhne wale (related) janwaron ka DNA milta julta hota hai jo unhein apne mushtarka buzurg se mila hai. Kyun ke DNA un proteins ke codes rakhta hai jin se har janwar banta hai, is liye related janwaron ke proteins bhi milte julte hote hain. Scientists mukhtalif jandaron ka DNA aur proteins nikal kar un ki banawat ka tajziya (analyse) kar sakte hain. Related proteins aur DNA ki banawat mein farq dhoond kar, aur yeh maan kar ke mutations taqreeban ek hi raftaar (constant mutation rate) se hoti hain, scientists andaza laga sakte hain ke mushtarka buzurg molecule se alag hue kitna waqt guzra hai.

blocks.title: How microorganisms have evolved resistance to antibiotics? (Jaraseem mein antibiotics ke khilaf muzahimat kaise aayi?)
blocks.text: Antibiotic resistance ka matlab hai ke bacteria antibiotic ke saamne bhi zinda reh sakte hain. Yeh bacteria ke genes mein mutations ki wajah se ho sakta hai. Antibiotic resistance ka gene, jo natural selection ke zariye bana, bacteria ki agli naslon mein muntaqil ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Jitne do jandar qareeb ke rishtedar hon, un ke DNA aur proteins mein utna kam farq hota hai. Farq ginne se pata chalta hai ke woh kitna pehle ek mushtarka buzurg se alag hue.

blocks.prompt: Protein ke farq se kaise andaza lagaya ja sakta hai ke do species kab alag huin?
blocks.explanation: Dono species ke ek hi protein (ya DNA) ki banawat mein farq ginein. Yeh maan kar ke mutations taqreeban ek hi raftaar se jama hoti hain, zyada farq ka matlab hai ke mushtarka buzurg se alag hue zyada waqt guzra.

items: Related jandaron ka DNA aur proteins milte julte hain (homologous biochemicals), kyun ke yeh mushtarka buzurg se aaye.
Molecular farq aur constant mutation rate se alag hone ka waqt andaza kiya jata hai.
Antibiotic resistance mutation se paida hoti hai aur natural selection se agli naslon mein jati hai.
